episodes.label: Trigger Event & Initial Sectarian Clashes
episodes.summary: The episode began on April 13, 1975 when unknown gunmen opened fire on a Christian church in Lebanon, triggering widespread sectarian clashes between Christian and Muslim communal factions that rapidly escalated to attacks on civilian targets including buses, private vehicles and residential areas.

episodes.label: Beirut Territorial Division & Militia Mobilization
episodes.summary: During this episode, Beirut was divided into separate sectarian enclaves controlled by warring militias, with the 'Green Line' forming the boundary between predominantly Christian-held East Beirut and predominantly Muslim/PLO-held West Beirut as militias fought to consolidate territorial control.

episodes.label: Syrian Troop Deployment in Lebanon
episodes.summary: During the 1975-1990 Lebanese Civil War, starting in June 1976, Syrian troops deployed into northern and eastern Lebanon to intervene in the domestic sectarian conflict, occupying parts of Lebanese territory until March 1978.

episodes.label: Israeli First Incursion (Operation Litani)
episodes.summary: Operation Litani was Israel's first large-scale military incursion into southern Lebanon launched in 1978 targeting Palestine Liberation Organization positions, as part of foreign interventions during the Lebanese Civil War.

episodes.label: Israeli Full Invasion & Siege of Beirut
episodes.summary: This episode covers the June to September 1982 full-scale invasion of Lebanon by Israeli forces targeting the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) based in Lebanon, which culminated in a months-long siege of the capital Beirut, ending with the expulsion of PLO leadership and fighters to Tunis, Tunisia.

episodes.label: Sabra and Shatila Massacre
episodes.summary: The Sabra and Shatila Massacre occurred in September 1982 during the 1982 Israeli invasion of Lebanon, following the assassination of Lebanese President Gemayel.

episodes.label: War of the Camps
episodes.summary: The War of the Camps is a series of large-scale conflicts during the fourth phase of the Lebanese Civil War, in which multiple Palestinian refugee camps were besieged and attacked by the Shiite Amal Movement.

episodes.label: Taif Agreement Negotiations
episodes.summary: Negotiations between Lebanese sectarian factions and stakeholders to end the 1975-1990 Lebanese Civil War, producing the Taif Agreement that adjusted political power-sharing between confessional groups.

episodes.label: Official End of Civil War & Syrian Hegemony Establishment
episodes.summary: This episode marks the official end of the 15-year Lebanese Civil War, implementation of Taif Agreement terms, and establishment of Syrian hegemony/occupation over Lebanon that lasted until 2005

stages.label: Initial Domestic Sectarian Conflict Outbreak
stages.summary: 1975年内战爆发,4月13日以不明枪手向基督教堂开火为始,基督教与伊斯兰教开始攻打对方; These militias formed largely along communal lines: the Lebanese Front (LF), led by the Phalangists... the Lebanese National Movement (LNM)... the Amal movement... the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO)

stages.label: Foreign Intervention Era (Syria & Israel)
stages.summary: Other participants in the war included Syria , Israel , and splintered contingents of the Lebanese Army; fue un escenario de enfrentamiento entre potencias regionales y mundiales mediante aliados interpuestos

stages.label: 1982 Israeli Invasion & Intra-Militia Conflicts
stages.summary: 1982年以色列再次侵入黎巴嫩并直捣首都贝鲁特; 难民营战争,是黎巴嫩内战期间第四阶段的一系列大规模冲突,在冲突中由多个巴勒斯坦难民营遭到什叶派组织“阿迈勒运动”围困和攻击

stages.label: Resolution & Taif Agreement Implementation
stages.summary: Result Taif Agreement Christian-to-Muslim representation in Parliament of Lebanon adjusted from ratio of 55:45 to 50:50; el final sólo fue posible cuando el contexto internacional se hizo más favorable, de manera que Siria pudo imponer un acuerdo de paz basado en su hegemonía
